findings.text: getattr(self.operator, "support_bank_bucket", None) reads an attribute that no code in the repository sets (git grep for support_bank_bucket over nova/, tests/ and scripts/ returns this line only), so the compile key always receives None and the shape bucket never distinguishes two programs. Section 1 requires the bucket to enter this existing key rather than a second cache, and docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/operator-bank.html:21 states that it does. As landed the claim is untrue: when the bank is wired into a solve route, two meshes padding to different buckets would share one cache key and could reuse a program compiled for the other bucket's operand shapes.
findings.title: the bucket key component resolves to None for every request

findings.text: from pathlib import Path is imported and never referenced anywhere in the module; ruff reports F401 on this line, so the file does not pass the repository's own lint.
findings.title: unused import of pathlib.Path

findings.text: BANK_MANIFEST_NAME = "bank.json" is defined and never used; write_bank publishes a payload named bank.npz with an inline json.dumps manifest, so the constant both misnames the artifact and is dead.
findings.title: BANK_MANIFEST_NAME names a file that is never written

findings.text: The after_suite record sets completed: true, but slugs/suite-rerun-slurm.out and both arms' exit.txt show tests/test_forward_compile_identity.py killed at exit 137 by the step cgroup OOM in BOTH arms. That is the file most directly concerned with compile identity for this change, and it produced no result in either arm, so the flag overstates the evidence the arms carry.
findings.title: after_suite records completed true for an arm that lost one file

findings.text: rubric.suite reads "missing - both suite arms were cut short at 32 of 69 files", while the checkpoint at line 10 and both suite records state 69/69 files with ARM_STATUS base=0 head=0. The stale line leaves the suite dimension reading as unanswered when it was answered.
findings.title: rubric.suite line contradicts the checkpoint and the suite records
